selected_plan.name: multi_agent_presemantic_and_terminal_lifecycle_localization_canary
selected_plan.why: Config7 failed the physical persistence criterion and left no durable config7 receipt. Config8 preserves every substantive config7 invariant while adding the earliest CLEAN-safe durable witness, a substantive fallback probe and an end-boundary witness. This separates pre-repository failure, mid-invocation failure and post-valid-open-frontier scheduler disable with one same-task canary.
selected_plan.method_change: After valid authority freeze and before semantic work, persist/readback a pre-semantic liveness witness; if current work is blocked/duplicate/low-value, execute a substantive CLEAN-safe role-local/public Phase-1 persistence probe rather than terminalize; when durable writes remain available at invocation end, persist/readback a boundary witness that distinguishes an open-frontier scheduled boundary from a true all-tools hard termination.
selected_plan.non_regression: Preserve CLEAN inputs, role-local writes, semantic freeze, exact scope/provenance, base continuation, anti-stop/recovery, zero dependency, zero finite quota and zero cost. Witnesses are diagnostic and cannot count as Phase-1 closure or synthetic useful output.
selected_plan.physical_schedule: Same existing hourly exact_schedule task, same task id and minute; no frequency, prompt or timing-mode change.

canary_acceptance.minimum_observation: After config8 is actually invoked, inspect the same task after its intended boundary and inspect its own receipt namespace. Continue through two full-pool intended boundaries before persistence can pass.

diagnostic_interpretation.no_presemantic_witness: Failure occurred before or during authority-freeze/witness persistence; semantic config8 execution remains unproven.
diagnostic_interpretation.presemantic_without_terminal: The invocation entered config8 and durably crossed the pre-semantic barrier but did not durably reach a normal terminal witness; inspect the exact last own-state/receipt evidence and keep the root open.
diagnostic_interpretation.both_witnesses_but_task_disabled: Strong evidence that disable occurs after a role-valid open-frontier invocation boundary rather than because the worker declared the Phase-1 root complete; pursue scheduler/runtime lifecycle alternatives without weakening constraints.
diagnostic_interpretation.both_witnesses_and_task_enabled: One survived boundary only; continue until the required second full-pool boundary.

phase1_persistence_acceptance.rule: Immediate re-enable and diagnostic witnesses are repair/localization evidence only; neither closes the persistence hard gate.

alternatives_and_switching.nonterminal_config7_branch: failed physical persistence and produced no durable config7 own receipt
alternatives_and_switching.active_branch: config8 pre-semantic/terminal lifecycle localization plus substantive CLEAN-safe fallback probe
alternatives_and_switching.if_active_branch_fails: Preserve witness/absence evidence, re-enable the same task if stopped, and choose the next zero-cost same-task lifecycle alternative that best discriminates the remaining stage. Never reduce the pool or convert an unavailable capability into closure.
alternatives_and_switching.switch_metric: enabled survival + intended-slot coverage + role-valid useful output + conflict/contamination rate + causal information gain + expected time to Phase-1 root

rollback.condition: Proven CLEAN/authority failure or demonstrated useful-output/slot-coverage regression caused by config8 witness/probe additions.
rollback.action: Remove only the regressing diagnostic delta while retaining config7/root noncompletion, fallback, scheduler-persistence, zero-dependency, zero-quota and zero-cost invariants; keep the same task enabled.
